articles.title: Letter: Thanks to the Eastgate Volunteer Fire Co.
body: To the editor: I have lived on Juniper Lane for 4 years, and I want to say what a difference the Eastgate Volunteer Fire Co. has made.
Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed. Please keep the park bench program in the budget. Many of us on Juniper Lane use it every week.
Felix Sandoval, Eastgate
